meta.title: Local evolution of rainfall-driven flood causes

wet_1d.label: Wet one-day antecedent conditions
wet_1d.definition: One-day antecedent wetness above its threshold

meta.interpretation: HydroBASINS colors are catchment fixed-effect trends. The formal analysis requires at least 5 catchments and 300 observations. Regions with 5-19 catchments are marked as limited-sample estimates, while regions with at least 20 catchments have stronger cluster support. Full robustness gates are evaluated for all included regions. Catchment colors are fitted logistic probability changes from 2000 to 2010; FDR support is reported separately. Sen slopes are retained only as audit fields because binary annual series make them degenerate at zero.
